author: Mark Atwood
text:
Fixed. CalendarEvent/copy create-path now distinguishes the two error conditions:
  - 'id' key absent: existing diagnostic unchanged (invalidProperties + properties:['id'])
  - 'id' key present but not a JSON string: adds description:'id must be a string' to the same shape

Both shapes are RFC 8620 §5.3 invalidProperties-conformant; the description field disambiguates them per RFC 8620 §5.3 (description is permitted in invalidProperties SetErrors). Added regression test copy_non_string_source_id_returns_invalid_properties_with_description that exercises three non-string id shapes (integer, null, object) and asserts all three carry the disambiguating description field. The existing copy_missing_source_id_returns_invalid_properties test now also asserts the missing-id case still omits 'description' (locks in the disambiguation contract from both directions). Verified: cargo fmt clean, clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo test --all-features 120 (was 119) passed.
